summary: [Vanguard] Dangote Cement Plc. has recorded a remarkable 60 per cent reduction in road traffic accidents, following the implementation of a comprehensive driver safety programme, underscoring the company's unwavering commitment to protecting lives and promoting road safety across its transportation operations.

title: Fix Logistics, Regulatory Bottlenecks to Grow Businesses - Pres Mahama
summary: [Ghanaian Times] President John Dramani Mahama has called for urgent reforms in Ghana's logistics and regulatory systems to reduce the cost of doing business and improve the competitiveness of local enterprises.

title: Susan Kushaba Denied Bail As Businesswoman Drags Feet On Public Apology to Kampala Ministers
summary: [Nile Post] Buganda Road Chief Magistrates court has denied bail to Kampala businesswoman, Susan Kushaba.

title: MPs Accuse Karamoja Development Projects of Fuelling Corruption As Famine Persists
summary: [Nile Post] The Parliamentary Committee on Presidential Affairs has accused officials of exploiting development projects in Karamoja for personal gain, saying billions of shillings spent on water infrastructure have failed to address the region's persistent food insecurity.

title: Chapo Announces Over Three Billion Meticais for Infrastructure Reconstruction
summary: [AIM] Maputo -- Mozambican President Daniel Chapo has announced an investment of over three billion meticais (about 47 million US dollars at the current exchange rate) for reconstruction of public infrastructures destroyed during mass demonstrations that followed the 2024 general elections.
